children: Roundtable appointed former UK Prime Minister Liz Truss to its board to lead a European Press Coalition leveraging its media OS.
Liz Truss joins Roundtable board to form a European Press Coalition focused on supporting professional journalism.
Company says Truss brings extensive public service experience to help expand and curate high-quality journalism.
Roundtable cites an assembled audience exceeding 100 million and a $100 million marketplace shared by premium media brands.
Firm promotes its AI/DeFi-powered media operating system as technology to empower human-led journalism and monetization.
